title: Theory coverage, composition, and observation assessment
unit: A formulation profile is one mathematical regime paired with one carrier; a carrier portfolio is a coverage envelope, not a proved integrated theory.

status_semantics.tie_rule: Local and literature results are equally direct but remain visibly distinct evidence types.

bundles.label: Kinematics and states
bundles.question: Does the formulation say what exists, what is observable, and how states are represented?

bundles.label: Prediction and observational bridge
bundles.question: Can it assign probabilities, select a physical state, and connect the formulation back to operational or standard predictions?

bundles.label: Dynamics and causality
bundles.question: Are the generator, evolution problem, and causal response all under control?

bundles.label: Gauge structure and interactions
bundles.question: Are gauge-redundant content and genuine interactions both constructed?

bundles.label: Quantum consistency chain
bundles.question: Are counterterms, anomalies, singular products, QME restoration, and residual transfer connected in the required order?

presets.label: Predictive physics chain
presets.description: A broad default for turning states and dynamics into operational predictions; it is not a definition of all physics.

presets.label: Causal classical/interacting chain
presets.description: Kinematics, states, well-posed causal dynamics, interactions, and reconstruction, without requiring the quantum-consistency tail.

presets.label: Quantum gauge completion
presets.description: The complete sixteen-obligation chain, including the ordered counterterm/anomaly/QME/residual-transfer requirements.

global_rails.label: Obligation coverage
global_rails.meaning: The tables can show where direct results, partial ingredients, explicit gaps, and unmapped cells occur.

global_rails.label: One coherent integrated theory
global_rails.meaning: Evidence in different cells may concern different models or scopes. No current certificate proves that a profile or carrier envelope composes into one jointly consistent theory.

global_rails.label: Agreement with observations
global_rails.meaning: The atlas has no typed dataset, likelihood, residual, parameter-fit, or out-of-sample prediction record. Reconstruction coverage is only a bridge-readiness proxy, not observational validation.

maximize: direct obligations in the default gate
assessed obligations in the default gate
pareto_definition.warning: Pareto membership is a navigation aid over present coverage, not a theorem ranking, probability, or empirical verdict.

does_not_establish: that direct evidence in separate cells composes into one theory
that a finite or reduced model has a controlled continuum limit
that reconstruction/limits coverage demonstrates agreement with observations
that NOT_MAPPED is failure, incoherence, or absence from the literature
that Pareto-frontier profiles are physically preferred or more likely true
a complete observationally validated theory under any regime or carrier portfolio
